concept.title: Understand Open Cap/Floor Transactions
concept.shortdesc: Explains the system processes triggered when opening a cap/floor contract, including premium calculations and ledger updates.

conbody.p: Opening a cap/floor contract triggers premium calculations, inventory position creation, and general ledger updates. Premiums are paid upfront and amortized over the contract life.

section.title: Calculation for Open Cap/Floor Transaction
section.p: The system uses the following formulas:

ul.li: Local Premium Value = (Quantity * Quantity Scale) * (Price per Contract * Price Multiplier)
Base Premium Value = Local Premium Value / Spot Exchange Rate to Base
